changes: New: The Assistant remembers each drawing's chats — the clock lists them, pick one to carry on; New chat keeps the one you leave; deleting asks first.
New: Click a picture in the Assistant's chat to see it large.
New: Alt+number-pad codes (Alt+0176 gives °), Alt+X as in Word, Ctrl+Shift+> and <, and Ctrl+L/E/R to align while typing; F1 lists them.
New: The Assistant's Change button is now a gear, to save room.
Fix: Arrowheads pasted into PowerPoint keep their sharp tips and corners.
Fix: Subscripts and superscripts sit where the page draws them while you type, and a space at the end of a line moves the caret.
